title: Hidden Agent folders
footer: Rules apply to every runtime on the selected computer. Paths hide that folder and its descendants; globs match working directories. ~ means that computer’s home. Sessions keep recording. Active supervised Persona tasks remain visible. Turn a rule off to show its sessions again.
empty: No hidden folders on this computer.
failed: Could not save or load rules: {error}
inspect_hint: Temporary view only. Assistant visibility and rules stay unchanged.
